versions.content: Service Name CBFidStatusChanged Syntax Std_ReturnType CBFidStatusChanged ( FiM_FidStatusChangeType Status, boolean Permission ) Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Status Set to INIT if the FiM is calling this callback due to the initialisation of the module. If set to CHANGED, this callback indicates a FID state change Parameters (in) Permission Indicates the initial/new FID permission state. TRUE: FID has permission to run FALSE: FID has no permission to run. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: this function always returns E_OK for compatibility reasons with RTE Description – Available via FiM.h
